g.text: Sequence Diagram - WEB06 Edit a Kitchen Configuration (ACTIVE one included; invalid edits, concurrent-change recovery by rebase on the reloaded version, language switch)
The editor was opened from SD 4 (consult) with KCF-00002, version = 3;
base = { name, content } of version 3 is kept for the whole edit session.
KCF-00002 may be the ACTIVE configuration: the viewer must never receive
unvalidated content (AC 6) and an invalid edit must keep the last valid one (AC 4).
(syntax error -> shown, nothing sent, as in SD 1)
load referenced assets and file availability (as in SD 1)
Stored row untouched: the viewer keeps
Conditional UPDATE: only succeeds if nobody
changed the row since version 3 was read.
"status" is not in the SET list, so a concurrent
they see either the previous valid row or
the new valid row, never a mix.
if ACTIVE: "The viewer will show the new layout
the next time it loads (Open / reload viewer)"
"This configuration no longer exists" + link to the list
draft: { name, text }, latest: null, rebase: null,
"This configuration was changed by another user.
Reload it before saving. Your changes are kept below."
Recovery after a concurrent change (client clarification 15)
Example: KCF-00002 v3 had name "Compact kitchen" and width 12.
The other Manager changed width 12 -> 14 (now v4). This Manager only renamed it to "Kitchen B".
The next save is built ON THE RELOADED RECORD (v4): only this Manager's own changes
(draft - base) are re-applied, so the other user's width 14 is kept. The whole draft
(which still has width 12) is never sent with the new version.
draft still shown and can be copied or saved as a new configuration (SD 1)
"Fix the JSON syntax of your draft to apply it
on the latest version, or discard it" (Save disabled)
no change of theirs on the same / overlapping path -> apply to candidate
same value in theirs -> nothing to do
different value -> conflict { path, base, mine, theirs }
elements matched by id; new elements appended after latest's
"Your changes re-applied on v4: name -> Kitchen B"
[Discard my draft] [Continue with the rebased version]
[ ] I reviewed the other user's changes (Save disabled)
name, text = latest; version = 4; base = latest;
text = candidate; version = latest.version (4); base = latest
editor shows the rebased JSON (new width 14 + new name)
ticks "I reviewed the other user's changes"
Save enabled only if every conflict is resolved
same server path as above (validation, conditional UPDATE ... WHERE version = 4)
the other user's width 14 AND the new name are stored
back to phase "conflict"; the rebased content is the new draft
and v4 the new base (the cycle repeats; nothing is overwritten)
issues listed; rebased content kept; review stays acknowledged
switches PT <-> EN in the layout header (WEB02)
LanguageContext changes; the page is NOT remounted
(route not keyed by language) and no effect depends
on the language, so nothing is fetched or reset.
same name, same typed or imported JSON,
same issues and same draft / comparison,
now in the selected language (no request sent)
receives version 4 only if the edit was
accepted; otherwise the previous valid version
